<section id="about" class="bio" aria-labelledby="about-title"><div><div class="eyebrow">Behind the photographs</div><h2 id="about-title">About Christopher</h2></div><div><p><strong>Christopher Beckett is a South Florida photojournalist based in Palm Beach County.</strong> His work is distributed through international photo agencies and published by national and international news organizations. He specializes in political coverage, aviation, weather, economic trends, and breaking news.</p><p>His photographs have appeared in Bloomberg, NBC News, The Washington Post, The Guardian, ABC News and Good Morning America, the Los Angeles Times print edition, Forbes, Associated Press, The Wall Street Journal, Yahoo, MSN, The Daily Beast, Page Six, the New York Post, the Daily Mail, The U.S. Sun, Fast Company, Salon, and AOL, with international usage including Newsweek Romania, Paris Match, Der Standard, Radio ZET, and Forum.</p><p>His photography is syndicated through NurPhoto, ZUMA Press Wire, SIPA USA, and Avalon, as well as other international distribution partners. His approach emphasizes timely coverage, accurate captions, and clear visual reporting.</p><div class="subjects" aria-label="Coverage areas"><span>Politics &amp; breaking news</span><span>Aviation</span><span>Weather</span><span>Economic trends</span></div></div></section>
